core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Kazakh word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Zhandos corresponds to the Kazakh form جَانْدُوس (Kazakh жан (soul) + дос (friend)). Its core sense is zhandos; soul-friend (kazakh). Zhandos is Kazakh, from жан ('soul') + дос ('friend'), meaning 'soul-friend'.
